facts.fact: Lei 10/2024, published in the Boletim da Republica on 7 June 2024, gives persons with disabilities a right of access to information and communication technologies and systems (Article 16) and says public service entities should provide service information in accessible formats, with sign-language training for State communicators (Article 17).

The ITU-EU VaMoz Digital project, supporting Mozambique's government 2023-2027, completed a digital accessibility assessment with special focus on persons with disabilities and ran digital accessibility awareness and training (5 webinars, 4 workshops, 3 focus groups) reaching 320+ stakeholders, according to ITU.
